question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word based on the context of the sentence.

He gave a __haughty__ consent without honouring him with a single word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"haughty"** means arrogantly superior and disdainful. (अहंकारी)

 
 
• **Example: **She gave him a **haughty** look and walked away without saying a word.
 
 
 
• **"Modest"** refers to having or showing a moderate or humble estimate of one's importance. (विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite his achievements, he remained** modest** and never boasted about his success.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'haughty'** is **'modest'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Happy** (खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

 
 
• **Example:** She was happy to see her friends after a long time.
 
 
 
• **Indifferent** (उदासीन): Having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned.
 
 
• **Example:** He was indifferent to the outcome of the match.
 
 
 
• **Proud** (गर्वित): Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements.
 
 
• **Example:** She was proud of her son's accomplishments.
